description: Creates a tag in a WinCC Unified HMI, in `table` or the default tag table. A tag WITHOUT `connection` is internal: dataType is required and plcName, plcTag, address, accessMode, acquisitionMode and acquisitionCycle are refused (400 bad_request). A tag WITH `connection` is external: the connection must exist (409 reference_not_found; tia_hmi_connections lists them), exactly one of plcTag or address is given, and dataType is optional. The PLC of a plcTag is plcName, else the one PLC the connection's partner resolves to (none or several: 409 plc_unresolved). A plcTag is a PLC tag or a data block member path (struct and UDT members, array elements with literal in-bounds indices): one that matches no tag or block is 409 reference_not_found, one that cannot be established is 409 plc_reference_unresolved (details.segment, reason), possibly a false refusal when the DB or a UDT is inconsistent: compile the PLC first. A PLC tag name with a dot is sent as ONE quoted token ("A.B"): two or more segments are always a data block member path, never matched against tags. A dangling reference is never written. A dryRun cannot check whether the attributes of the not-yet-existing object are writable: a real create refused for that reason (409 hmi_attribute_not_writable or hmi_attribute_list_unavailable) removes the object it made and verifies it gone. Refused, nothing changed: 400 invalid_name (details.kind, name, rule) for a blank, over-long or malformed name, 409 name_collision (details.existing) for a used name, 400 invalid_data_type, 400 bad_request for fields that do not fit the rule above, 409 hmi_attribute_list_unavailable, hmi_attribute_unreadable or hmi_attribute_not_writable when the serve cannot read or may not write what it needs. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs every guard the real write runs and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", hmi, ...} with no `postcheck`, changing nothing. A real write answers the re-read values and a `postcheck` {verified:true, requested, actual}; a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches, details.rollback: restored, not_restored or not_attempted): re-read before anything else. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to POST /hmi/{hmi}/tags. M-off.

accessMode.description: external tags only: SymbolicAccess or AbsoluteAccess; defaults from whether plcTag or address was given and must agree with it

acquisitionCycle.description: external tags only: the acquisition cycle as text, only with CyclicOnUse or CyclicContinuous

acquisitionMode.description: external tags only: OnDemand, CyclicOnUse or CyclicContinuous

address.description: external tags only: the absolute address of the value in the PLC; give this or plcTag, never both

connection.description: HMI connection name (from tia_hmi_connections) that makes the tag external; omit for an internal tag

dataType.description: tag data type, one of Bool, Byte, Char, DInt, DWord, Int, LInt, LReal, LWord, Real, SInt, String, UDInt, UInt, ULInt, USInt, Word, WChar, WString, DateTime or Time; anything else is 400 invalid_data_type with details.allowed

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

name.description: tag name: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores, at most 128 characters; unique across every tag table and the system tags, ignoring case

plcName.description: external tags only: the PLC the plcTag belongs to; omit when the connection's partner resolves to exactly one PLC

plcTag.description: external tags only: a PLC tag name, or a DB.Member path to a real member for symbolic access (struct and UDT members, array indices literal and in bounds); give this or address, never both. A PLC tag name with a dot is sent as ONE quoted token ("A.B"): two or more segments are always a data block member path, never matched against tags. A path that cannot be established is 409 plc_reference_unresolved, details.reason being not_a_data_block, member_not_found, not_an_array, index_out_of_range, index_not_constant, type_unresolved, interface_unreadable or unsupported_syntax

table.description: tag table to create it in (from tia_hmi_tag_tables); omit for the default tag table

name: tia_hmi_tag_create
title: TIA — create HMI Unified tag
